Research and Development and Investments in Technology
paragraphs: At Modine Manufacturing Company, we are Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World ™. For more than 100 years, we have been a trusted leader in designing, engineering, testing, and manufacturing mission-critical thermal solutions. Our technologies heat, cool and ventilate, with systems that drive performance, efficiency, and reliability for our customers. Our technologies support our mission to improve indoor air quality, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. We help customers across industries solve complex thermal management challenges and meet increasingly stringent indoor and outdoor air, energy, and water standards.

We sell customer-centric thermal management solutions in a wide array of commercial, industrial, and building heating, ventilating, air conditioning, and refrigeration ("HVAC&R") markets. In addition, we are a leading provider of engineered heat transfer systems and high-quality heat transfer components for use in on- and off-highway original equipment manufacturer ("OEM") vehicular applications. Our primary customers across the globe include:
Developers and operators of data centers; - Healthcare facility operators and K-12 school systems;
Heating, ventilation and cooling OEMs; Construction architects and contractors; Wholesalers of heating equipment;
Agricultural, industrial and construction equipment OEMs; Commercial and industrial equipment OEMs; and
Truck, bus, automobile and specialty vehicle OEMs.

We partner with our customers to provide solutions including systems, services, and components to solve complex heat transfer challenges and are committed to helping them reach their sustainability goals. We focus on product design, from raw materials to end-of-life recyclability, to optimize the total cost of ownership and reduce negative environmental impacts across the product life cycle. We anticipate and prepare for change in order to be at the forefront of technological advances and to provide innovative solutions to help our customers meet their sustainability targets and comply with an increasingly stringent regulatory environment.

Modine was incorporated under the laws of the State of Wisconsin on June 23, 1916 by its founder, Arthur B. Modine. A.B. Modine's "Turbotube" radiators became standard equipment on the famous Ford Motor Company Model T. In response to frigid Wisconsin winter temperatures and inadequate heating options in the market, A.B. Modine combined a radiator, a fan and steam pipes to construct the first unit heater, marking the start of our heating business. When he died at the age of 95, A.B. Modine had personally been granted more than 120 U.S. patents for his heat transfer innovations. The standard of innovation exemplified by A.B. Modine remains the cornerstone of Modine today.

Our heritage provides a depth and breadth of expertise in thermal management, which, when combined with our global manufacturing presence, standardized processes, and state-of-the-art technical resources, enables us to rapidly bring highly-valued, customized solutions to our customers.

When we use the terms "Modine," "we," "us," the "Company," or "our" in this report, unless the context otherwise requires, we are referring to Modine Manufacturing Company. Our fiscal year ends on March 31 and, accordingly, all references to a particular year mean the fiscal year ended March 31 of that year, unless indicated otherwise.

Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ guides our strategic direction. Our mission is to use our thermal management expertise to help our customers improve indoor air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use more environmentally friendly refrigerants. We are committed to evolving our product portfolio in pursuit of highly engineered, mission-critical thermal solutions. We are strategically investing in end markets where we see the highest growth prospects. These markets continue to shift to low-carbon energy solutions, driving demand for cleaner, more efficient thermal management.

We first announced our vision for a "new" Modine in late fiscal 2021. Over the last five fiscal years, we have simplified and re-segmented our organization and have aligned resources around specific strategies and market-based verticals. Our leadership and teams have embraced 80/20 principles, which focus on the rule that 80 percent of outputs result from 20 percent of inputs. Our teams have created a high-performance culture that focuses resources on products and markets with the highest sustainable growth opportunities and best return profiles, while simplifying and improving our processes.

Following our 80/20 discipline during fiscal 2026, we significantly expanded our Data Centers business and production capacity and are continuing to grow this business to meet increasing customer demand. We see great opportunity in growing our Data Centers business in light of trends in high-performance computing, with significant data center growth fueled by artificial intelligence ("AI"), resulting in a commensurate need for data center cooling solutions. In addition, we acquired three businesses during fiscal 2026, AbsolutAire, Inc. ("AbsolutAire"), LBW Holding Corp. ("L.B. White"), and Climate by Design International ("Climate by Design"), which contributed to growth in our HVAC Technologies business. In January 2026, we entered into definitive agreements with Gentherm Incorporated ("Gentherm"), whereby we will spin-off and simultaneously combine our Performance Technologies segment businesses with Gentherm in a Reverse Morris Trust transaction. Gentherm, a Michigan-based corporation, is a global leader of innovative thermal management and pneumatic comfort technologies. This transaction, which we expect will close by the end of calendar 2026, will transform our company into a pure-play climate solutions company focused on the data center and commercial HVAC&R markets. Through our application of 80/20 principles, we are achieving transformative change.

During fiscal 2026, our consolidated net sales were $3.2 billion, a 23 percent increase from $2.6 billion in fiscal 2025, primarily driven by higher sales in our Climate Solutions segment. The higher Climate Solutions segment sales included significant sales growth to hyperscale and colocation data center customers and $119 million of incremental sales from businesses we acquired during fiscal 2026. Our operating income of $342 million in fiscal 2026 increased $59 million from the prior year, primarily due to higher gross profit.

paragraphs: In the ordinary course of our business, we face various market, operational, strategic, financial and general risks. These risks could have a material impact on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows. Please consider each of the risks described below, along with other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, when making any investment decisions with respect to our securities.

Our Enterprise Risk Management process seeks to identify and address material risks. We believe that risk-taking is an inherent aspect of operating a global business and, in particular, one focused on growth and cost-competitiveness. Our goal is to proactively manage risks in a structured approach in conjunction with strategic planning, while preserving and enhancing shareholder value. However, the risks set forth below and elsewhere in this report, as well as other risks currently unknown or deemed immaterial at the date of this report, could materially adversely affect us and cause our financial results to vary materially from recent or anticipated future results. These disclosures reflect our beliefs and opinions as to factors that could materially and adversely affect the Company and its securities in the future. References to past events are provided by way of example only and are not intended to be a complete listing or a representation as to whether or not such factors have occurred in the past or their likelihood of occurring in the future.

We operate in numerous countries on four continents and serve customers in a wide array of commercial, industrial, HVAC&R, and vehicular markets. As such, our business is impacted by general economic, political, and industry conditions globally as well as in the regions and countries in which we conduct business. We are subject to the risk of disruptions or significant deterioration in market conditions, which could have a material impact on our business, financial position, results of operations and cash flows. Geopolitical tensions and military conflicts, including the conflict between the U.S. and Iran, as well as related regional instability or proxy conflicts, could negatively impact or cause significant business disruptions in the global markets we operate in. Ongoing conflicts and any potential further escalation, could lead to significant disruption near major oil producing regions or in shipping corridors and could result in higher energy and fuel prices, shipping delays, increased freight and manufacturing costs, and increased cyberattacks from state-sponsored or other actors. Such developments could also contribute to broader inflationary pressures across the global economy and supply chains, including increased costs for materials, transportation and labor, which may not be fully recoverable through pricing and could impact the availability, reliability, and overall viability of certain supply sources.

In addition, customer demand for our products and system solutions is impacted by the overall strength of the economy, employment levels, consumer confidence levels, the availability and cost of credit, and the cost of fuel. For example, rising interest rates associated with inflationary market conditions may drive a higher cost of capital for our customers, which may have a deteriorating impact on overall economic activity and the financial condition of our customers, which could negatively impact the demand for our products. Prolonged recessionary or adverse economic conditions, such as disruptions in the global financial system, could result in our customers or suppliers experiencing significant economic constraints, including potential bankruptcies.

There is uncertainty regarding future relationships between the U.S. and numerous other countries, particularly China, Canada, Mexico, and in Europe, with respect to trade policies, tariffs, treaties, and government regulations. Changes in U.S. policies could lead to changes to existing trade agreements, significant increases in tariffs, more restrictions on free trade, and restrictions on the importation of certain goods and components into the U.S. or other countries. A trade war or escalation of trade tensions, including increased tariffs and retaliatory measures by foreign governments, should they be sustained for an extended period of time, or changes in U.S. or international trade agreements, could negatively impact our supply chain, increase costs, and reduce demand for our products. Changes to or uncertainty in the marketplace related to U.S. social, political, regulatory and economic conditions or in laws and policies related to foreign trade in countries where we currently manufacture and sell our products, and any resulting negative sentiments towards the U.S., could adversely affect our business, financial position, results of operations and cash flows.

In February 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that tariffs imposed in 2025 under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act were invalid (the "IEEPA Ruling"). However, other tariffs remain in effect and trade policies are unpredictable. There is also uncertainty with regard to the IEEPA Ruling, including the availability and timing of refunds, the potential for new tariffs to be invoked under alternative laws, the impacts on trade agreements between the U.S. and other countries, and the expectations of customers, suppliers, and others impacted by the tariffs. In addition, the rapid evolution, reversal, or replacement of trade measures following the IEEPA Ruling may contribute to increased policy volatility and uncertainty, which could complicate planning, pricing, sourcing, and contractual arrangements.

paragraphs: Fiscal 2026 net sales increased $598 million, or 23 percent, from the prior year, primarily due to higher sales in our Climate Solutions segment, driven by higher sales of data center products and $119 million of incremental sales from the three businesses that we acquired during fiscal 2026. Cost of sales increased $510 million, or 26 percent, primarily due to the higher sales volume. Gross profit increased $87 million. Gross margin declined 190 basis points to 23.0 percent and was negatively impacted by temporary operating inefficiencies associated with the rapid expansion of our Data Centers business and higher material costs in both of our operating segments. SG&A expenses increased $28 million and included higher costs associated with our strategic acquisition and disposition activities. Operating income of $342 million during fiscal 2026 increased $59 million from the prior year, primarily due to higher gross profit and lower restructuring expenses, partially offset by higher SG&A expenses. During fiscal 2026, we recorded a $116 million non-cash pension termination charge in connection with the termination of our primary U.S. pension plan.

Fiscal 2025 net sales increased $175 million, or 7 percent, from the prior year, primarily due to higher sales in our Climate Solutions segment, partially offset with lower sales in our Performance Technologies segment. Cost of sales increased $58 million, or 3 percent. Gross profit increased $118 million and gross margin improved 310 basis points to 24.9 percent. SG&A expenses increased $58 and included higher compensation-related expenses and higher expenses from Scott Springfield Manufacturing, including amortization expense for acquired intangible assets. Operating income of $283 million during fiscal 2025 increased $42 million from the prior year, primarily due to higher gross profit, partially offset by higher SG&A and restructuring expenses and the absence of a $4 million gain on the sale of three automotive businesses in Germany in fiscal 2024.

paragraphs: 在 Modine Manufacturing Company，我們致力於工程一個更清潔、更健康的地球 ™。超過 100 年來，我們一直是設計、工程、測試及製造關鍵性熱管理解決方案的受信領先者。我們的技術可進行加熱、冷卻與通風，並透過系統提升客戶的性能、效率與可靠性。我們的技術支持我們改善室內空氣品質、降低有害排放、實現更清潔運行的車輛，並使用環境友善的冷媒。我們協助各產業客戶解決複雜的熱管理挑戰，並符合日益嚴格的室內與室外空氣、能源與水準標準。
我們銷售以客戶為中心的熱管理解決方案，應用於廣泛的商業、工業與建築加熱、通風、空調與冷氣（"HVAC&R"）市場。此外，我們也是工程熱傳系統與高品質熱傳零組件的領先供應商，用於道路與非道路原廠設備製造商（"OEM"）車輛應用。我們在全球的主要客戶包括：
資料中心的開發者與營運者；- 醫療機構營運者與 K-12 學校系統；
加熱、通風與冷氣 OEM；建築師與承包商；加熱設備經銷商；
農業、工業及建設機械原廠製造商；商業及工業機械原廠製造商；以及
貨車、巴士、汽車及特殊車輛原廠製造商。
我們與客戶合作，提供包含系統、服務及零組件的解決方案，以解決複雜的熱傳導挑戰，並致力於協助客戶達成其永續目標。我們著重於產品設計，從原物料到產品終期回收性，以優化總擁有成本，並降低產品生命週期中對環境的負面影響。我們預見並準備應對變化，以處於科技進步的前沿，並提供創新解決方案，協助客戶達成其永續目標，並符合日益嚴格的監管環境。

Modine 於 1916 年 6 月 23 日根據威斯康辛州法律成立，由其創辦人 Arthur B. Modine 所設立。A.B. Modine 的 "Turbotube" 散熱器成為著名的福特汽車公司 Model T 的標準配備。為回應威斯康辛州嚴寒的冬季氣溫及市場上不充足的加熱選項，A.B. Modine 將散熱器、風扇及蒸汽管組合，製造出第一臺單元式加熱器，標誌我們加熱業務的開始。在他 95 歲離世時，A.B. Modine 已 personally 被授予超過 120 項美國專利，表彰其熱傳導創新。A.B. Modine 所代表的創新標準，至今仍是 Modine 的核心價值。
我們的歷史背景提供了在熱管理領域的深度與廣度的專業知識，結合我們的全球製造據點、標準化流程以及最先進的技術資源，使我們能迅速為客戶提供高價值的客製化解決方案。
當我們在本報告中使用 "Modine"、"we"、"us"、"the Company" 或 "our" 這些詞語時，除非文意另有要求，否則我們指的是 Modine Manufacturing Company。我們的會計年度於 3 月 31 日結束，因此所有提及特定年份的參考皆指該年 3 月 31 日結束的會計年度，除非另有說明。

我們的宗旨 "Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™" 引導我們的戰略方向。我們的使命是運用我們在熱管理領域的專業知識，協助客戶改善室內空氣品質、降低能源與用水消耗、減少有害排放、實現更清潔的運行車輛，並使用更環保的冷媒。我們致力於持續進化我們的產品組合，追求高度工程化且關鍵性的熱管理解決方案。我們正在戰略性地投資於我們認為成長潛力最高的終端市場。這些市場持續轉向低碳能源解決方案，推動對更清潔、更高效熱管理的剛性需求。
我們在財務 2021 年晚期首次宣佈我們對 "new" Modine 的願景。在過去五個財務年度中，我們簡化並重新劃分了組織結構，並將資源集中於特定策略與市場導向的垂直領域。我們的領導層與團隊已接受 80/20 原則，該原則強調 80% 的輸出來自 20% 的輸入。我們的團隊已建立高績效文化，將資源集中在具有最高可持續成長潛力的產品與市場，並具備最佳回報潛力，同時簡化並改善我們的流程。

根據我們在財務 2026 年的 80/20 原則，我們大幅擴展了資料中心業務與生產能力，並持續成長此業務以應對日益增加的客戶需求。我們看到在高運算效能計算趨勢下，資料中心業務有極大的成長機會，特別是人工智慧（"AI"）所驅動的資料中心大幅成長，導致對資料中心冷卻解決方案的相應需求。此外，我們在財務 2026 年收購了三家企業，包括 AbsolutAire, Inc.（"AbsolutAire"）、LBW Holding Corp.（"L.B. White"）以及 Climate by Design International（"Climate by Design"），這些收購促進了我們 HVAC 技術業務的成長。2026 年 1 月，我們與 Gentherm Incorporated（"Gentherm"）簽訂了最終協議，我們將透過反向莫里斯信託交易，將我們的 Performance Technologies 事業部門與 Gentherm 合併並分拆。Gentherm 是一家位於密歇根州的公司，是創新熱管理與氣壓舒適技術的全球領導者。這筆交易，我們預期將在 2026 年年底前完成，將我們的公司轉型為專注於資料中心與商業 HVAC&R 市場的純粹氣候解決方案公司。透過我們對 80/20 原則的應用，我們正在實現轉型變革。

在財務 2026 年，我們的合併淨銷售額為 32 億美元，較財務 2025 年的 26 億美元成長 23%，主要驅動因素為 Climate Solutions 事業部門銷售額的增加。較高的 Climate Solutions 事業部門銷售額包括對超規模與共用資料中心客戶的重大銷售成長，以及來自我們在財務 2026 年收購的企業的 1.19 億美元增量銷售。我們在財務 2026 年的營運獲利為 3.42 億美元，較前一年成長 5900 萬美元，主要原因是毛利率的提高。

本公司營運成果可能因客戶的價格壓力而受到不利影響。
本公司價格策略可能對新業務的整體獲標率產生負面影響。
全球氣候變遷及各相關利害關係人對永續目標的重視，可能對本公司業務產生負面影響。
持續且增加的競爭可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司受國際業務及全球客戶與供應商基礎相關風險影響。
維持具競爭力的成本結構的挑戰
本公司可能無法維持具競爭力的成本結構。
技術優勢、產品開發及產品發佈的挑戰
若本公司無法以技術區隔於競爭對手，本公司現有及潛在客戶可能尋求較低價格，而本公司銷售及獲利可能受到不利影響。
與智慧財產權權利相關的發展或聲請，可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
本公司於全球各設施 regularly 發佈新產品及系統設計。這些發佈的成功對本公司業務及營運成果至關重要。
本公司可能因資訊科技（"IT"）系統的重大中斷，或資訊科技系統服務提供者之資訊科技系統的重大違約，而受到不利影響。
我們可能因環境、健康與安全規範的費用而受到負面影響。
我們可能因保証及產品責任聲請與訴訟或其他法律程序而產生重大損失及費用。
待決反向莫里斯信託交易
我們在與Gentherm進行反向莫里斯信託交易期間，將面臨風險與不確定性。
我們可能無法實現與待決反向莫里斯信託交易與Gentherm所預期的部分或全部效益。
對於待決反向莫里斯信託交易與Gentherm所組成之合併公司股份價值，無法保證其對我們股東而言具有價值。
我們戰略性地聚焦於成長我們的資料中心業務。我們可能無法實現預期的資料中心客戶銷售成長。
我們的業務策略包括收購與處分。我們可能無法識別、執行並成功整合收購，或成功執行戰略性業務處分。
我們的負債可能限制我們使用現金流量來支持營運、開發及投資活動，且未能遵守我們的債務契約可能不利於我們的流動性與財務結果。
我們的資產負債表包含大量商譽與無形資產。這些資產的重大減損將不利於我們的財務結果。
我們可能面臨額外的所得稅費用或面臨額外的稅務風險。
我們的營運成效依賴於我們所服務的客戶與市場的健康狀況。
作為一家全球性公司，我們會受到外幣匯率波動的影響，進而影響我們的財務結果。
我們未來的成功取決於我們吸引、培訓並留住合適人才的能力。
paragraphs: 本公司在日常營運中，面臨各種市場、運營、戰略、財務及一般風險。這些風險可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果及現金流產生重大影響。請考慮下列所描述的風險，以及本年度報告表10-K中包含的其他資訊，以做出任何有關本公司證券的投資決策。

本公司企業風險管理程序旨在識別並處理重大風險。本公司認為風險承擔是經營全球業務的內在部分，特別是針對成長與成本競爭力的業務。本公司目標是以結構化的方式，與戰略規劃結合，主動管理風險，同時維護並提升股東價值。然而，下列所列風險及其他處於本報告中的風險，以及目前未知或被認為不具重大性的風險，可能對本公司產生重大不利影響，並導致本公司財務結果與近期或預期未來結果產生重大差異。這些披露反映本公司對可能對本公司及其證券產生重大不利影響的因素的觀點與信念。對過往事件的提及僅為範例，並非完整清單，亦不表示這些因素是否已發生過或其未來發生的可能性。

本公司在四大洲的多個國家營運，並服務於廣泛的商業、工業、 HVAC&R 及車輛市場。因此，本公司業務受全球及本公司營運地區與國家的總體經濟、政治與產業條件影響。本公司面臨市場條件中斷或顯著惡化風險，這可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果及現金流產生重大影響。地緣政治緊張與軍事衝突，包括美國與伊朗之間的衝突，以及相關區域不穩定或代理人衝突，可能對本公司營運的全球市場產生負面影響或造成重大業務中斷。持續的衝突及任何潛在進一步升級，可能導致主要石油生產地區或運輸走廊出現重大中斷，並導致能源與燃料價格上升、運輸延誤、運費與製造成本增加，以及來自國家支持或其它行動者的網路攻擊。這些發展也可能導致全球經濟與供應鏈的廣泛通貨膨脹壓力，包括材料、運輸與勞動成本增加，這些成本可能無法完全透過價格回收，並可能影響某些供應來源的可得性、可靠性與整體可行性。
此外，客戶對本公司產品與系統解決方案的需求，受總體經濟強度、就業水平、消費者信心、信貸可得性與成本，以及燃料成本的影響。例如，與通貨膨脹市場條件相關的利率上升，可能導致客戶的資金成本提高，這可能對總體經濟活動與客戶的財務狀況產生惡化影響，進而對本公司產品的需求產生負面影響。持續的經濟衰退或不利經濟條件，例如全球金融系統的中斷，可能導致客戶或供應商面臨顯著的經濟限制，包括潛在的破產。

未來美國與多個國家，特別是中國、加拿大、墨西哥及歐洲的關係存在不確定性，特別是在貿易政策、關稅、條約與政府規範方面。美國政策的變更可能導致現有貿易協議的變更、關稅顯著增加、自由貿易更多限制，以及某些商品與零組件進口至美國或其他國家的限制。貿易戰或貿易緊張關係升級，包括增加關稅與外國政府的報復措施，若持續一段長時間，或美國或國際貿易協議的變更，可能對本公司供應鏈產生負面影響，提高成本，並降低本公司產品的需求。與美國社會、政治、規範與經濟條件或與本公司目前製造與銷售產品的國家相關的外貿法律與政策的市場變動或不確定性，以及由此產生的對美國的負面觀感，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與現金流產生不利影響。

2026年2月，美國最高法院裁定2025年根據國際緊急經濟權力法案（IEEPA）所課徵的關稅無效（稱為「IEEPA 裁決」）。然而，其他關稅仍有效，且貿易政策難以預測。此外，對IEEPA 裁決也存在不確定性，包括退款的可得性與時間、根據其他法律課徵新關稅的潛在可能、美國與其他國家之間貿易協議的影響，以及客戶、供應商及其他受關稅影響者的預期。此外，IEEPA 裁決後，貿易措施的快速演變、反轉或更換，可能導致政策變動與不確定性增加，這可能使規劃、定價、來源與契約安排變得複雜。
